role: The Record tab's root SwiftUI view: owns all Record-tab @State, lays out the section stack, presents tag picker / pre-score prompt / morning and quick results covers, routes errors and overnight auto-acceptance, and hosts the interrupted-workout strap-recovery card.
types: RecordView: struct (View) — Record tab root; observes DeviceStatus/StreamingLifecycle/SessionState/MorningCoordination/SettingsManager from the environment

RecordView.ResultsPresentation: struct (Identifiable) — session+result snapshot captured at presentation time, id = session.id, plus the split night's linked segments read off-main before presenting (nil by default)
RecordView.ExtendedCaptureMode: enum (String, CaseIterable, Identifiable) — streaming / internalCapture / both capture choice for overnight recording
state: @State selectedTags: Set<ReadingTag> (view-local, lost when view is recreated)

@State showingTagPicker, sessionNotes, showingError (private), morningPresentation, quickPresentation, pendingMorningPresentation, fetchFailed, isRetrying, showingDiscardConfirm, confirmingReadingDiscard (the acceptance card's Discard confirmation), isDiscarding, sleepEditSaveFailed, quickDiscardFailed, tagSaveFailureMessage (String?: why a tag/note edit on an archived reading was not stored)
@State isRecoveringWorkout, workoutRecoverMessage (private), interruptedWorkoutId: UUID?, recoveredWorkoutFailure: String? (why the recovered-workout card's last Save or Discard stored nothing)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: selectedSessionType defaults to .overnight, extendedCaptureMode defaults to .both (overwritten onAppear by restoreCaptureMode), breathingAudio is a fresh BreathingAudioManager per view identity. Comment RecordView.swift says recording-state reads go through the observed sub-objects (a read through an RRCollector forwarder is tracked too but hides the dependency). Environment reads: \.dependencies (the reanalysis service and saved-session reanalysis the morning and quick result sheets call), RRCollector and the observed sub-objects.

units.does: Captures the session, its result and the linked segments (default nil), with id = session.id so the cover is keyed to the session.
Identifiable id for ExtendedCaptureMode: returns rawValue ('streaming'/'internalCapture'/'both').
units.entry: Identifiable conformance used by ForEach in captureModePicker (RecordView+Panels.swift).

units.does: Localized segment label for each capture mode.

branches.effect: returns localized 'Streaming'
returns localized 'Internal'
returns localized 'Both'

units.does: Root body: recordSurface (which carries the Error alert), onChange of sessionState.lastError (stringified) → presentErrorIfActionable, onChange(initial: true) of needsAcceptance → routeOvernightAcceptance (also on first build, so a night finalised before the tab existed is accepted), onAppear → restoreCaptureMode, onChange of deviceStatus.connectedDeviceType → coerceCaptureModeForDevice.
units.entry: SwiftUI body of RecordView, created by MainTabView's Record tab.

units.does: Wraps recordScroll in the tag-save failure alert and the Error alert (each shown only while no results cover is up; each cover carries its own), then the navigation title 'Record', background, the tag-picker sheet (showingTagPicker), and three fullScreenCovers keyed on pendingMorningPresentation (pre-score prompt), morningPresentation (morning results) and quickPresentation (quick results).
True while any results cover is presented: the pre-score prompt, the morning results or the quick results.
ScrollViewReader around ScrollView{recordStack}; scrolls to top when scrollToTopToken changes; .task runs resolveInterruptedWorkout once per appearance.
units.entry: SwiftUI view; .task fires on appear, onChange on scrollToTopToken (set by MainTabView re-tap).

units.does: VStack of the thirteen Record sections in render order (session type, selected header, tags, connection, recoverable data, workout recovery, active session, morning processing, live data, verification, morning preview, quick results, acceptance), padded and id'd 'recordTop' for scroll-to-top.
Async: asks the collector for an interrupted workout id (crash flag or newest un-archived workout backup, scanned off-main) and stores it in interruptedWorkoutId, which drives strapRecoverySection.
reads: file:raw RR backups (WorkoutTrackBackup header scan, last 24h)

units.does: Builds TagPickerSheet bound to selectedTags with settings.allTags as available tags.
units.entry: Sheet content when showingTagPicker is true.

units.does: Full-screen PreScorePromptView carrying the Error alert (always shown here); on completion (answer or skip) writes the feeling via applyMorningFeelingAnswers, clears pendingMorningPresentation and sets morningPresentation to the same snapshot so the results cover opens.
units.entry: fullScreenCover(item: $pendingMorningPresentation); completion closure fired by PreScorePromptView.

units.does: Attaches the 'Error' alert (errorAlertActions / errorAlertMessage, the humanised lastError) to content, presented while `shown` and showingError are both true; dismissing it sets showingError false. The screen passes shown = no cover up, each cover passes true, so the alert appears wherever the user is.
units.entry: SwiftUI view composition from recordSurface, preScoreCover, morningCover and quickCover

branches.effect: alert presented here

units.does: OK button of the error alert, running acknowledgeError.

Error alert OK. With fetchFailed set, does nothing: the Retry card keeps its reason (lastError) and session and has its own Dismiss. Otherwise resets a stale .failed session (resetSession also clears lastError) and clears lastError, so the same error raised again re-presents.

branches.effect: true: return, nothing changes
true: collector.resetSession()

branches.effect: true: showingError=true; false: nothing (errors during overnight streaming are never re-shown later by this handler)

branches.cond: streamingLifecycle.isPaused && getPersistedCaptureMode() != nil (the recording marker's useDeviceInternalBackup, else the paused night's capture choice)
branches.effect: true: restore from it (+3); false: check !isOvernightStreaming (+4)
true: extendedCaptureMode=.both; false: .streaming (internalCapture never restored)

unknown/garbage stored raw value falls back to .both

true: 'Recovering…'; false: 'Recover workout from strap'

units.does: Task: sets recovering flag, calls collector.recoverInterruptedWorkoutFromStrap; on a non-nil session clears interruptedWorkoutId (review card then appears from MorningCoordination), on nil shows 'Couldn't recover — make sure the strap is connected'.

branches.effect: true: interruptedWorkoutId=nil (card hides); false: workoutRecoverMessage set, card stays

units.does: Task: if a current session exists, re-scores the latest archived version with the pre-session tags/notes added (scoreLatestVersion, exports metrics), which reports whether that re-archive was stored (true when there is no session); then on main finishAutoAccept leaves review, raises the tag-save failure alert when the picked tags/notes were not stored, and clears the pre-night selection either way.

branches.effect: true: tagsStored = await scoreLatestVersion; false: log 'currentSession is nil — skipping', tagsStored = true

units.does: Clears acceptance state in the collector; when the re-archive carrying the pre-night selection was not stored and the user had picked tags or notes, logs a warning and sets tagSaveFailureMessage ("The tags and notes you picked for this reading couldn't be saved. Add them again from History."). Then always empties selectedTags and sessionNotes, so the selection never carries over onto another night.

branches.effect: log a warning and raise the tag-save failure alert; the selection is cleared either way

units.does: Fetches the archived copy of the session off-main (falls back to the in-memory one if retrieval fails), adds the pre-session tags/notes (preSessionTagged), and recomputes/re-archives its composite recovery score with HealthKit export enabled, so the tags reach the archive with the score; returns whether that re-archive was stored.

branches.effect: log only: prints 'nil' when no source summary
archive retrieve failed → scores the in-memory session
log text 'FAILED — using in-memory session' vs 'OK'; second ?? on same line logs 'nil' source
